styles.name: drag-tree
styles.description: Drag-race Christmas tree: amber lights cascade top-to-bottom, then GREEN GO fires

styles.name: tachometer
styles.description: Semicircular tach dial: needle sweeps idle→redline; shift light flashes at redline

styles.name: fuel-gauge
styles.description: Fuel gauge: needle pivots E→F on a semicircular dial; low-fuel blink below 15%

styles.name: lap-circuit
styles.description: Oval track: a car dot circuits the loop; lap fraction = eased; ghost car trails behind

styles.name: pit-stop
styles.description: Pit stop: 4 tyre corners fill one by one; all done = car flashes and GO fires

styles.name: gear-shifter
styles.description: H-pattern gear shifter: stick hops 1→6 through the gate as progress grows

styles.name: odometer
styles.description: Odometer: digit columns roll from 00000 to 99999 as progress grows; smooth block ramp

styles.name: tunnel-headlights
styles.description: Perspective tunnel: converging road lines; headlight beams widen as the car approaches

styles.name: burnout
styles.description: Burnout: rubber tyre marks accumulate right-to-left as progress grows; fishtail via time

styles.name: pistons
styles.description: 4 engine pistons fire in sequence driven by time; RPM grows with eased

styles.name: nitro-boost
styles.description: Nitro boost charge: fills left-to-right; a spike surges past the head; full charge erupts

styles.name: checkered-flag
styles.description: Checkered finish flag: unfurls as progress grows; at 100% the flag ripples via sine wave
